svg.text: SUMMIT PUSH — DRAWING 1 OF 6 - FIELD TOP VIEW (PLAN)
Field 648 x 324 in (54 ft x 27 ft) - scale 1.8 px/in - Blue alliance at left
CLIMB LINE X = 48 / 600, full width - G416 line call
CRAG APRON 36 shelf & peg faces / 20 socket faces / R20
OUTFITTER LANE 36 x 48, centered on the chute
FIELD CENTERLINE 2-in white at X = 324 - G402 / G502 line call
CENTER CACHE band side lines + nine white marks
socket (LOW, MID; SUMMIT on the shelf face)
BASE DEPOT tray, a ring round the CRAG
SCREE PATCH, ridges as laid (SCREE panel)
Each type appears once per row and once per column.
Aggregate haul distance is identical for both alliances (725.0 in each).
All tape 2.0 in wide; the line edge sits on the stated coordinate.
Alliance-colored tape for alliance zones; white for neutral marks.
The centerline and the CENTER CACHE side lines break at the inner
edge of the APRON tape: Blue Y 198-282, Red Y 42-126.
CRAG plan tint is a drafting convention; the CRAG itself is tan
Model the Blue half once, then rotate-pattern 180 deg about (324, 162).
Centers are CRITICAL. Each Red twin is the Blue
patch rotated 180 deg about (324, 162), ridges alike.
Y: along the Y axis, across the +X travel.
across S2, normal to its ridges
Patch 30.0 x 30.0 (CRITICAL), sides on the field
axes, laid directly on the carpet (no base plate).
and 3.5 wide at the base. Centerlines +/-4.0 and
+/-12.0 from the patch center, measured along the
ridge normal: 8.0 pitch (CRITICAL). Each ridge runs
straight across and is cut square at the patch edge.
18 patches, nine in each half of the FIELD. Each half
All dimensions in INCHES. Heights are to the robot-interaction surface (shelf top, socket rim center, peg root, rung top, tag center).
Boxed values are CRITICAL - hold exactly. Values suffixed (ref) may float +/-0.25 in. Every angle on the field is 15, 30 or 45 degrees.
Coordinate frame: always-blue-origin NWU. Origin at the right corner of the Blue alliance wall; +X toward Red, +Y left, +Z up. Blue half shown; Red = 180 deg rotation about (324, 162).
Units: INCHES | Scale: as noted per view
